title: When the Wreck Burns
author: Jude Sandoval
blurb: Marguerite Coldharbour, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
